summary: Describes an LDAPv3 control that lets a client ask a directory server to return search results in pages instead of all at once. The client fetches one chunk at a time and asks for the next, which keeps large searches manageable. This is an informational memo, not a standard.

eli5.summary: Imagine asking a librarian for every book about dogs. Instead of a giant pile, she hands you a few at a time and you ask for more when ready.

questions: how does ldap paged search work
ldap control for paging search results
